text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E at large gains felt satisfying, but I should trim only when its outlook or portfolio weight justifies it—not simply to lock in a win.","I added to Stock B at higher prices; before buying more, I should reassess its fundamentals, valuation, and position size rather than chase recent performance.","After several months without trades, the account declined; I should review holdings against clear risk and investment criteria, while avoiding reactive trading based on frequent account checks."]}
